title: Articles - Indefinite Article (illustrative readable prompt)
hint: Say the word 'elephant' aloud. Does it start with a vowel sound or a consonant sound?
prompt: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo yesterday.
sentence: I saw @@@ elephant at the zoo yesterday.

feedback.correct: Excellent! 'An' is correct because 'elephant' starts with a vowel sound.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. 'Elephant' starts with a vowel sound, so we use 'an' (not 'a').
